
# 香农指数

## 加载包

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(export)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(multcompView)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

### 加载数据集

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
physeq = readRDS("./data/dada2/microplate/filtered/physeq.rds")
sample_data(physeq)$cell_num = as.factor(sample_data(physeq)$cell_num)

physeq
```

### 测序抽平

```{r}
# sample.size: 抽平到的深度（通常取所有样本中的最小值，或者一个固定的阈值）
# rngseed: 必须设置随机数种子，保证结果可重复
set.seed(123)
ps_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(physeq, 
                             sample.size = 20000, 
                             rngseed = 123, 
                             replace = FALSE)

ps_rare
```

### 多样性指标计算

```{r}
plot_richness(ps_rare, x = "cell_num", measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Chao1", "Simpson")) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.format") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

plot_richness(ps_rare, x = "carbon", measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Chao1", "Simpson")) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.format") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

plot_richness(ps_rare, x = "class", measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Chao1", "Simpson")) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.format") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

## 构建多样性分析数据集

### 初始细胞数驱动多样性增加

### 多样性提升未显著增强群落生物膜形成能力

```{r}
shannon_index = estimate_richness(ps_rare, measures = c("Shannon")) |> 
    rownames_to_column(var = "sampleID") |>
    left_join(data.frame(sample_data(ps_rare)) |> mutate(sampleID = as.character(sampleID))) |> 
    mutate(cell_num = as_factor(cell_num),
           carbon = factor(carbon),
           growth = str_sub(class, 1, 2),
           biofilm = str_sub(class, 3, 4)
           ) |> 
            as_tibble()

plots = lapply(c("carbon","cell_num","class"), function(x){
    ggplot(shannon_index, aes(.data[[x]], Shannon)) +
        geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
        stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.format") +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Shannon Index") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 10), aspect.ratio = 1.2)
})

final_plot =cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots, nrow = 1, labels = "auto", align = "hv")

print(final_plot)
```
```{r}
shannon_index <- estimate_richness(ps_rare, measures = "Shannon") %>%
  rownames_to_column("sampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(sample_data(ps_rare)) %>%
      mutate(sampleID = as.character(sampleID)),
    by = "sampleID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_num = as_factor(cell_num),
    carbon = factor(carbon),
    growth = str_sub(class, 1, 2),
    biofilm = str_sub(class, 3, 4)
  ) %>%
  as_tibble()

plot_shannon <- function(x) {
  dat <- shannon_index %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[x]]), !is.na(Shannon))
  form <- reformulate(x, response = "Shannon")

  dunn <- rstatix::dunn_test(
    dat, formula = form,
    p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"
  )

  p_values <- dunn$p.adj
  names(p_values) <- paste(dunn$group1, dunn$group2, sep = "-")

  letters <- multcompView::multcompLetters(
    p_values,
    threshold = 0.05
  )$Letters

  y_range <- diff(range(dat$Shannon, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (y_range == 0) y_range <- 1

  letter_data <- dat %>%
    mutate(level = as.character(.data[[x]])) %>%
    group_by(level) %>%
    summarise(
      y = boxplot.stats(Shannon)$stats[5] + 0.08 * y_range,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(letter = letters[level])

  p_y <- max(letter_data$y, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.12 * y_range

  ggplot(dat, aes(.data[[x]], Shannon)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_text(
      data = letter_data,
      aes(level, y, label = letter),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(
      method = "kruskal.test",
      label = "p.format",
      label.y = p_y
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Shannon Index") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 30,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 10
      ),
      aspect.ratio = 1.2
    )
}

plots <- lapply(
  c("carbon", "cell_num", "class"),
  plot_shannon
)

final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plotlist = plots,
  nrow = 1,
  labels = "auto",
  align = "hv"
)

print(final_plot)
```

### Chao1和观测值

```{r}
richness_df = estimate_richness(ps_rare, measures = c("Chao1", "Observed")) |> 
    mutate(sampleID = sample_names(ps_rare)) |> 
    left_join(data.frame(sample_data(ps_rare)) |> mutate(sampleID = as.character(sampleID)), by = "sampleID") |> 
    mutate(cell_num = as_factor(cell_num),
           carbon = factor(carbon),
           growth = str_sub(class, 1, 2),
           biofilm = str_sub(class, 3, 4)
           ) |> 
    as_tibble()

plots_chao1 = lapply(c("carbon","cell_num","class"), function(x){
    ggplot(richness_df, aes(.data[[x]], Chao1)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
        geom_jitter(data = function(d) dplyr::slice_sample(d, prop = 0.2), 
                   alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2, color = "gray30") + 
        stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.format") +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Chao1 Index") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 10), aspect.ratio = 1.2)
})

plots_obs = lapply(c("carbon","cell_num","class"), function(x){
    ggplot(richness_df, aes(.data[[x]], Observed)) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
        geom_jitter(data = function(d) dplyr::slice_sample(d, prop = 0.2), 
                   alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2, color = "gray30") + 
        stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.format") +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Observed Index") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 10), aspect.ratio = 1.2)
})

final_plot = cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = c(plots_chao1, plots_obs), nrow = 2, labels = "auto", align = "hv")

print(final_plot)
```

### 均匀度

```{r}
richness_df <- estimate_richness(
  ps_rare,
  measures = c("Chao1", "Observed", "Shannon")
) %>%
  mutate(sampleID = sample_names(ps_rare)) %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(sample_data(ps_rare)) %>%
      mutate(sampleID = as.character(sampleID)),
    by = "sampleID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_num = as_factor(cell_num),
    carbon = factor(carbon),
    growth = str_sub(class, 1, 2),
    biofilm = str_sub(class, 3, 4),
    Evenness = if_else(
      Observed > 1,
      Shannon / log(Observed),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  as_tibble()

group_vars <- c("carbon", "cell_num", "class")

plot_alpha <- function(metric, y_label) {
  lapply(group_vars, function(x) {
    ggplot(richness_df, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[metric]])) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      geom_jitter(
        data = function(d) slice_sample(d, prop = 0.2),
        alpha = 0.5,
        size = 1.2,
        color = "gray30"
      ) +
      stat_compare_means(
        method = "kruskal.test",
        label = "p.format"
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))
      ) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = y_label) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(
          angle = 30,
          hjust = 1,
          size = 10
        ),
        aspect.ratio = 1.2
      )
  })
}

plots_evenness <- plot_alpha("Evenness", "Pielou's Evenness")

final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plotlist = c(
    plots_evenness
  ),
  nrow = 3,
  ncol = 3,
  labels = "auto",
  align = "hv"
)

print(final_plot)

export::graph2ppt(final_plot,  width=7, height=7.5,file = "evenness_index.ppt")
```
